feeds.title: Eat With Afia
feeds.description: My name is Afia Amoako and I am the creator and curator of this blog. In this blog, you will find tasty recipes that are easy, cheap, and pay homage to my Ghanaian roots. In addition to food, I share tips about living a healthy lifestyle and share more about my Ghanaian identity as well as some tasty eats from around the African content.

feeds.title: Destination Vancouver
feeds.description: Inside Vancouver is a multi-author Vancouver blog and in this segment, the expert writes & recommends food & drinks to try. Our goal is to give an insider's view of Vancouver, to provide information, stories, and opinions from the locals' perspective about this great city, and profile some of the many things to do in Vancouver.

feeds.title: WanderEater Magazine
feeds.description: WanderEater Magazine is Canada's Food & Travel magazine. For Canadians traveling aimlessly for food. Showcasing the world's hottest culinary destinations, recipes, drinks, gear (in the kitchen, and on the go), chef features and more.

feeds.title: Earth, Food, and Fire
feeds.description: Become a better home cook with from-scratch cooking hacks, tips, tricks, and weekly recipe updates. I love anything cooking, gardening, and foraging related.

feeds.title: Baking for friends
feeds.description: Learn easy baking recipes for your favorite desserts, cookies, main dish recipes, and more. Find the best baking tips and tricks at Baking for Friends.

feeds.title: Kalofagas » Recipes
feeds.description: The following section of Kalofagas features easy-to-follow and delicious recipes. Welcome to the official Kalofagas-Greek Food & Beyond website of Peter Minaki. Peter is one of Canada's finest Toronto-based Greek food experts. Kalofagas created a blog in 2010 that would introduce the world to the delicious depths of Greek cuisine, with many unique twists to the thousands of flavourful and mouth-watering recipes.

feeds.title: Taste Toronto
feeds.description: TasteToronto thrives to inspire those looking to discover all Toronto has to offer. Through our coverage of food, drink, events, and trending stories, we aim to inform our readers about our booming food scene. From the trendiest spots to the hidden gems, our team is dedicated to unearthing the city's best-kept secrets.
